label: Regulatory Interpretation
description: Interpret financial services regulations, identify obligations, cross-reference delegated acts, and translate legal text into practical compliance requirements.

guidedInputs.label: Which regulation or legal text?
guidedInputs.description: Specify the regulation, directive, or legal text you need interpreted.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., AMLR 2024/1624, GDPR Article 35, DORA Article 28, PSD3...

guidedInputs.label: Specific articles or sections (optional)
guidedInputs.description: Leave blank to interpret the whole instrument or scope.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Articles 28-30, Chapter IV, Title II

guidedInputs.label: Relevant jurisdictions
guidedInputs.description: Select all jurisdictions that need to be considered.

guidedInputs.label: What type of entity?
guidedInputs.description: The entity type affects which provisions and proportionality thresholds apply.

guidedInputs.label: Why do you need this interpretation?
guidedInputs.description: This shapes how the analysis is structured and what to emphasise.

guidedInputs.label: Additional context (optional)
guidedInputs.description: Any specific questions, concerns, or angles you want explored.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., We are a small payment institution — which proportionality provisions apply? What are the transitional provisions?
